question: How many of our patients are recorded as male, as female, and as neither (indeterminate)?
note: Counts patients per administrative sex: male, female, indeterminate.

question: How many hospital stays were inpatient, outpatient or day-care stays?
note: Counts hospital stays (and patients) per type of care handling: inpatient, outpatient, day care.

question: How long do hospital stays last? Give the number of stays and the average, shortest and longest stay in days.
note: Length of stay in days (discharge minus admission) over all hospital stays: count, average, minimum, maximum.

question: How many patients had at least one lab test in each year from 2000 to 2009?
note: Counts patients with a lab test performed in each calendar year 2000-2009 (by the date the test was performed).

question: How many deaths were reported in each year from 2015 to 2025?
note: Counts death records (and patients) per year of the death report, 2015 to 2025 inclusive.

question: What is the civil status breakdown of our patients: how many are married, single, divorced, widowed, separated from a partner, or living with a partner without being married?
note: Counts patients per civil status (six categories).

question: What is the average body mass index over all recorded BMI values, and how many patients have at least one BMI on file?
note: Average of all body mass index values, with the number of BMI records and of patients.

question: How many patients received a transplant made from their own tissue, and how many received one from a donor?
note: Counts transplants and patients per graft type: graft from the patient's own tissue versus graft from a donor.

question: How many recorded allergies carry a low, a high, or an undetermined risk rating, and how many patients does each group cover?
note: Counts allergy records and patients per allergy risk rating: low, high, undetermined.

question: How many patients are recorded as current smokers, as former smokers, and as lifelong non-users of tobacco?
note: Counts patients per tobacco use status: current smoker, former smoker, lifelong non-user.

question: How many patients were followed up by telephone, and how many through a consultation? Also give the number of follow-ups of each kind.
note: Counts patients and follow-up records per kind of follow-up: telephone versus consultation.

question: Across all blood pressure readings, what are the average systolic and diastolic pressures, and how many readings and patients are they based on?
note: Average systolic and diastolic pressure over all blood pressure readings, with counts of readings and patients.

question: What percentage of all our patients has cholera on a hospital bill, and how many patients is that?
note: Share of all patients with at least one billed cholera diagnosis (any rank, any subcode).

question: How many patients have a do-not-resuscitate decision on file, and what share of all patients with any resuscitation directive is that?
note: Patients with a do-not-resuscitate directive (parent code plus its subtypes, via inference) among patients with any resuscitation directive.

question: From 2010 through 2020, how many patients had cholera billed as the principal diagnosis, and how many such diagnoses were recorded?
note: Principal-rank billed cholera diagnoses recorded in 2010-2020 inclusive: patients and diagnoses.

question: Of the patients who received radiotherapy, how many also had cancer surgery, and what percentage is that?
note: Among patients with any radiotherapy procedure, the number and share who also have an oncology surgery.

question: Which ten medical specialties see the most patients who have cholera on a hospital bill? Give the number of those patients and of their encounters per specialty.
note: Top 10 specialties of healthcare encounters by number of patients with a billed cholera diagnosis (no tie at the cutoff: 13 vs 12).

question: Of the patients who were given drugs in hospital, what share also had an adverse event recorded?
note: Among patients with any drug administration, the number and share with at least one adverse event.

question: How many patients have a disease of the respiratory system (ICD-10 J codes) on a hospital bill, and how many such billed diagnoses are there?
note: Billed diagnoses in the ICD-10-GM respiratory chapter (J00-J99, via chapter inference): patients and diagnoses.

question: How many patients started radiotherapy within 90 days after a cancer surgery?
note: Patients with a radiotherapy start that is later than the start of an oncology surgery and at most 90 days after it.

question: How many patients have high blood pressure (hypertension) on a hospital bill, and how many of them also have blood pressure readings on file?
note: Patients with a billed hypertension diagnosis (ICD-10 I10 and subcodes) and how many of them have any blood pressure record.

question: For inpatient, outpatient and day-care stays, what share of stays has at least one billed procedure?
note: Per care type, number of stays and number and share of stays with at least one billed procedure linked to the stay.

question: For each kind of consent (general, specific, or no consent required), how many patients accepted, refused, or were only informed, and what percentage refused?
note: Per consent type, counts of patients by consent status (accepted, refused, informed) and the refusal percentage.

question: How many patients had a death reported within 365 days after a cholera diagnosis was billed?
note: Patients whose death report date falls 0-365 days after the record date of a billed cholera diagnosis.

question: Do patients with cholera on a hospital bill stay longer in hospital than other patients? For each group, give the number of patients and the average, shortest and longest stay in days.
note: Cohort comparison (billed cholera vs. no billed cholera) of length of stay in days: patients, average, minimum, maximum.

question: For each kind of radiotherapy, how many patients and procedures are there, how many days does a procedure last on average, and what share of the procedures was given with palliative intent?
note: Per radiotherapy code: patients, procedures, average start-to-end duration in days, and percentage of procedures with a palliative intent.

question: How many healthcare encounters do patients have? Group patients with at least one encounter into 1, 2 to 5, 6 to 20, and more than 20 encounters, with the number and percentage of patients in each group.
note: Distribution of patients by number of healthcare encounters (buckets 1, 2-5, 6-20, >20) with percentages of patients having any encounter.

question: For each insurance coverage type, how many patients are there, what is their average hospital stay in days, and what percentage of them has cholera on a hospital bill?
note: Per insurance coverage type: patients, average length of stay in days, and number and share of patients with a billed cholera diagnosis.

question: By sex, what are the average BMI and the average systolic blood pressure (each averaged over all recorded values), and how many patients contribute to each average?
note: Per administrative sex: patients with BMI values and their average BMI, patients with blood pressure readings and their average systolic pressure (UNION avoids cross-multiplying the two measures).

question: What is the median length of a hospital stay in days, and how does it compare with the average stay?
note: Median length of stay (smallest stay length whose cumulative count reaches half of all stays) next to the average, over all hospital stays.

question: For allergies versus intolerances, how many records and patients are there, how many records are confirmed, suspected, refuted, or were recorded by mistake, and what percentage is confirmed?
note: Per reaction type (allergy vs. intolerance): allergy records, patients, counts per verification status and the confirmed percentage.

question: For the five medical specialties with the most healthcare encounters, give the number of patients, the number of encounters, the average encounter length in hours, and the longest encounter in hours.
note: Top 5 specialties by encounter count with patients, encounters, average and maximum encounter duration in hours.

question: For each year from 2010 to 2025, how many patients had any diagnosis billed that year, how many had cholera billed that year, and what share of those patients had cholera?
note: Per record year 2010-2025: patients with any billed diagnosis that year, patients with a billed cholera diagnosis that year, and the cholera percentage.

question: Compare patients with a do-not-resuscitate decision with patients whose directive says to resuscitate: how many patients are in each group, how many and what share of them have a recorded death, and what is their average hospital stay in days?
note: Cohorts by resuscitation directive (do-not-resuscitate vs. resuscitate, each with its subtypes via inference): patients, patients with a death record and share, average length of stay.

question: Among patients with at least one billed diagnosis, how many billed diagnoses does a patient have on average and at most, and how many patients have more than one?
note: Per-patient count of billed diagnoses (subquery), then patients, average, maximum and number of patients with more than one.

question: How did the yearly numbers of cancer surgeries, radiotherapy procedures and billed procedures develop from 2015 to 2025?
note: Per start year 2015-2025: counts of oncology surgeries, radiotherapy procedures and billed procedures (UNION of three record types).
